definitionZh: 文本对齐的 CSS 属性在一个块元素或表格单元格框内设置线内级内容的水平对齐. 这意味着它的工作方式是纵向对齐,但在水平方向上.
sourceDefinition: The text-align CSS property sets the horizontal alignment of the inline-level content inside a block element or table-cell box. This means it works like vertical-align but in the horizontal direction.
